stories.title: L'agonia di Christa Pike, cronaca di una esecuzione fallita

en.title: The agony of Christa Pike, chronicle of a failed execution
en.summary: A death row inmate's execution in the United States involved two injections that failed to cause death, with witnesses describing disturbing scenes. The incident raises questions about whether the execution method constitutes torture under law.

stories.title: Parigi e le banlieue in fiamme: la rabbia degli studenti travolge la Francia

en.title: Paris and the suburbs in flames: students' anger sweeps across France
en.summary: High school and university students in France are leading protests against government budget cuts and police actions, citing teacher shortages, poor classroom conditions, and concerns about university admission procedures.

stories.title: Campo largo, Schlein non cambia idea: “Leader chi vince ai gazebo o guida il partito più votato”

en.title: Broad coalition, Schlein does not change her mind: "Leader is whoever wins at grassroots meetings or leads the most-voted party"
en.summary: The Democratic Party secretary will reiterate her position on coalition leadership today, calling for caution and urging party members not to yield to provocations regarding the leader question.

stories.title: Sgarbi in rianimazione, l’ira della figlia Evelina: “Colpa di chi lo ha esibito tutta l’estate”

en.title: Sgarbi in intensive care, daughter Evelina's anger: "Fault of those who displayed him all summer"
en.summary: Art critic Vittorio Sgarbi was hospitalized with respiratory failure and is in critical but stable condition. His daughter blames those who kept him publicly active throughout the summer for his health crisis.

stories.title: I Poggi non saranno parte civile contro Sempio: “Non chiediamo soldi alle persone innocenti”

en.title: The Poggi family will not be a civil party against Sempio: "We do not ask innocent people for money"
en.summary: The victim's family will join proceedings only if the trial against Stasi is reopened. Their lawyer claims negative test results were due to equipment failure.

stories.title: Gli studenti come i narcos, a Marsiglia il macabro “barbecue” per bruciare un preside

en.title: Students like narcos, Marseille's macabre "barbecue" to burn a principal
en.summary: Working-class neighborhoods controlled by drug traffickers have become social powder kegs, with recent incidents involving student unrest and violence against school administrators.

stories.title: Dalla testata a Materazzi a ct della Francia: Zidane incrocia ancora l’Italia

en.title: From the headbutt to Materazzi to France coach: Zidane crosses Italy again
en.summary: Twenty years after Italy's 2006 World Cup victory, Zinedine Zidane's debut as France's coach is set to occur against the Italian national team.

stories.title: Benigni, 'San Francesco potrebbe essere stato un ottimo leader del Campo Largo'

en.title: Benigni, 'Saint Francis could have been an excellent leader of the Broad Left'
en.summary: Appearing on Vespa's Cinque Minuti program, Benigni discussed Saint Francis as someone deserving of love for his proclamation of equality before God.

stories.title: Protesta degli studenti in Francia: preside attaccato a Marsiglia. Le Pen accusa Mélenchon

en.title: Student protest in France: principal attacked in Marseille. Le Pen accuses Mélenchon
en.summary: Student demonstrations that began over a week ago in Paris suburbs protesting teacher shortages and inadequate funding have spread and intensified. The prime minister convoked a crisis meeting.

stories.title: Sopravvive a due dosi di iniezione letale: il Tennessee sospende l’esecuzione di Christa Pike

en.title: Survives two lethal injections: Tennessee suspends execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: Convicted of murder in 1996, Christa Pike's execution was halted after two pentobarbital doses failed. Governor Bill Lee suspended proceedings and ordered an independent investigation.

stories.title: Sopravvive a due dosi di iniezione letale: il Tennessee sospende l’esecuzione di Christa Pike/ Video

en.title: Tennessee Suspends Execution of Christa Pike After Surviving Two Lethal Injections
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman convicted of a 1995 murder survived two doses of pentobarbital during her execution in Tennessee. Governor Bill Lee has ordered an independent investigation into the incident.

stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni. Ricoverata in ospedale

en.title: USA, Supreme Court clears way for execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections. Hospitalized
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court authorized the execution of a 50-year-old woman convicted for a crime committed as a teenager, but she survived two injection attempts and was hospitalized. The state governor subsequently suspended her death sentence.

stories.title: Rai, sui conti l’incognita Rai Way Obiettivo pareggio alla fine del 2026

en.title: Rai, accounting uncertainty on Rai Way Goal break-even by end of 2026
en.summary: The Italian broadcaster's group accounts returned to losses, though management expects to reach break-even by the end of 2026. Revenue projections worsened compared to earlier targets during the year.

stories.title: «Attrattivi per la qualità del nostro ecosistema»

en.title: «Attractive for the quality of our ecosystem»
en.summary: Barbara Cimmino from Confindustria comments on the results of the first Foreign Companies Barometer, noting both positive findings and areas requiring attention.

stories.title: Imprese estere, fiducia più alta nei servizi. Pesa l’incertezza

en.title: Foreign companies, higher confidence in services. Uncertainty weighs
en.summary: Confindustria's first barometer measured in August the expectations of internationally-controlled companies operating in three sectors, finding stronger confidence in the services industry.

stories.title: Via al Salone dell’eccellenza nautica, in ripresa anche i piccoli cantieri

en.title: Launch of the Nautical Excellence Showcase, small shipyards also recovering
en.summary: The Genoa nautical show is opening with aspirations to become the world's leading boat exhibition, while smaller shipyard operators report recovery.

en.title: Ambienta bets on Norwegian aquaculture
en.summary: Ambienta Sgr, an investment firm founded by Nino Tronchetti Provera focused on sustainability, has acquired Norwegian aquaculture companies BioMarine, Flatsetsund Engineering, and Smir through its Ambienta IV fund.
